name: Dog CEO
tagline: Free random dog breed images for memes, placeholders, and demos
description: Dog CEO provides a free public REST API that serves random and breed-specific dog photos from a large community image collection. Developers can list breeds and sub-breeds, fetch one or many random images, and filter by breed without authentication. It is widely used for placeholders, demos, teaching HTTP, and lightweight fun apps. Responses are simple JSON with a status field and message payload. No API key or paid plan is required for the public endpoints.

auth.details: No authentication required. Public GET endpoints can be called without an API key or account.

pricing.free_tier_limits: Fully free public API; no paid plans. Concrete free request quotas not published.

use_cases: fetch a random dog image for a placeholder or meme
list all dog breeds and sub-breeds
get multiple random images of a specific breed
demo HTTP GET and JSON parsing with a zero-auth API
pick breed-filtered images for a UI gallery or quiz
